title: Peripheral blood DNA methylation predicts the early onset of primary tumor in TP53 mutation carriers.
authors: Subasri, Vallijah; Brew, Benjamin; Laverty, Brianne; Erdman, Lauren; Guha, Tanya; Hansford, Jordan R; Cairney, Elizabeth; Portwine, Carol; Elser, Christine; Finlay, Jonathan L; Nichols, Kim E; Anson, Jo; Kohlmann, Wendy; Gong, Haifan; Lees, Jodi; Alon, Noa; Brunga, Ledia; Villani, Anita; de Andrade, Kelvin C; Khincha, Payal P; Savage, Sharon A; Schiffman, Joshua D; Pugh, Trevor J; Malkin, David; Goldenberg, Anna
one_liner_zh: 该文用外周血甲基化数据预测TP53突变携带者早发肿瘤，属于临床风险预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Li-Fraumeni syndrome (LFS) confers high lifetime cancer risk due to germline TP53 pathogenic variants (PV). A comprehensive surveillance regimen termed the 'Toronto Protocol', has been adopted for early tumor detection, demonstrating improved survival among TP53 PV carriers. However, the protocol's "one-size-fits-all" approach fails to consider individual cancer risk. To personalize screening, we developed a support vector machine model to predict early onset of primary tumors (age < 6) using peripheral blood methylation data of TP53 PV carriers (n = 237). Validation (n = 64) and external testing (n = 79) showed AUROC = 0.928 [0.835-1.000], F1-score = 0.692 [0.435-0.867], and NPV = 0.984 [0.946-1.000]. The model achieved 91% accuracy, correctly classifying 90% of patients with cancer before the age of six and 87% of cancer-free individuals in the external test set. Our tool enables risk stratification for early-onset malignancies, to optimize clinical surveillance and improve patient outcomes.
abstract_zh: Li-Fraumeni综合征（LFS）因胚系TP53致病性变异（PV）而赋予个体较高的终身癌症风险。一项名为“多伦多方案”的综合监测方案已被采纳用于早期肿瘤检测，并显示出可改善TP53 PV携带者的生存率。然而，该方案的“一刀切”方法未能考虑个体癌症风险。为实现个性化筛查，我们开发了一种支持向量机模型，利用TP53 PV携带者（n = 237）的外周血甲基化数据预测原发肿瘤的早发（年龄 < 6岁）。验证（n = 64）和外部测试（n = 79）显示AUROC = 0.928 [0.835-1.000]，F1分数 = 0.692 [0.435-0.867]，阴性预测值（NPV）= 0.984 [0.946-1.000]。该模型实现了91%的准确率，在外部测试集中正确分类了90%的六岁前患癌患者和87%的无癌个体。我们的工具能够对早发性恶性肿瘤进行风险分层，以优化临床监测并改善患者预后。
